content.short: Mangrove is an on-chain order-book DEX enabling liquidity providers to post arbitrary smart contracts as offers.
content.description: Mangrove addresses liquidity fragmentation and underutilized capital in DeFi through its offer-is-code approach. This design enables liquidity providers to maximize asset utilization with advanced limit orders and on-chain automated strategies. Liquidity can be shared, borrowed, or lent and displayed in Mangrove's on-chain order book, ready to be sourced when an offer is hit.
content.meta: Mangrove is an on-chain DEX with order book that lets liquidity providers post arbitrary offers. Discover Mangrove and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
